about_the_game:
Save carry-over: No (progress will reset in the full release)
Planned updates: This demo will evolve as development continues.

What you can do

Campaign – play the first 2 story missions set in the Verdant Highlands.

Skirmish – one map (“Frontier Pass”) against up to 1 medium-difficulty AI empire.

Economy – build Tier-1 structures (farm, lumber camp, quarry, gold mine) and basic conveyor belts; tweak worker-AI priorities.

Army – recruit four core units: Peasant, Archer, Man-at-Arms, Catapult.

Research – tech tree up to “Stone Fortifications”.

Languages – Turkish, English, French, Italian, German (same as full game).

What’s missing vs. full game

Remaining 10 campaign missions (total = 12).

Advanced buildings (blacksmith, siege workshop, mage tower), Tier-2/3 units, army special abilities.

Multiplayer skirmish & online co-op.

Dynamic events, achievements, trading cards, full soundtrack.

This build is for balance and performance testing; your feedback will shape future demo updates.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4600 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Broadband internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560

short_description: Pixel Empires is a pixel-art real-time strategy game where you build and manage medieval colonies, automate resource gathering with intuitive AI, explore uncharted lands, and wage tactical battles to expand your empire’s reach.
